MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 5

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

3. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 22
   D. 15

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 25
   C. 17
   D. 31

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

9. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 40.5

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

12. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

13. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

21. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

22. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

23. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

24. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 26

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

27. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

28. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 11

29. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

30. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
